answer: Wharf admits a new island only when incumbents whose haven sums above the square of wharf's current island count countersign its entry; each countersignature burns the signer's entire haven and resets its tenure. Haven is the square of uninterrupted attested epochs, so a thousand-clone flood burns on the order of a third of the cube of its size in haven, attached to each island's entry. No signer can back two islands, and parallel batches still need distinct signers against a rising threshold. It breaks if haven transfers or wharf batches unsigned entries.
